reference.source: longitudinal profile dE/dt = E0 b (bt)^(a-1) e^(-bt) / Gamma(a), PDG RPP 2024, Passage of particles through matter (pdg.lbl.gov/2024/reviews/rpp2024-rev-passage-particles-matter.pdf), Eqs. 34.34-34.36 (fits to EGS4 showers, carbon to uranium, 1 to 100 GeV)
